messages:
Sam (AE): FYI Contoso sent back the redlined MSA + an attached PO asking for net45. they're asking that the POC order form include an SLA line and a security questionnaire answer pack. can we triage?
Diego (SE): On infra, 1x V100-equivalent for 14 days is what they asked. That maps to our short trial SKU. Need to confirm whether they want token-based billing or flat POC fee. Also they attached a 3rd-party SOC attestation request.
Aisha (Buyer-Contoso): correct. procurement prefers net45. also our security team needs a short answers doc for the DPA: encryption at rest + transit, KMS usage, and audit logs retention period. can you include contact for SOC report access?
Rina (Legal): MSA redlines: they added a reverse indemnity clause and requested an escrow-style source deposit. both are non-starters. propose counter: keep indemnity mutual (standard) and offer a code escrow referral but no source deposit.
Tomas (Finance): net45 unusual for POCs but doable if contracts mark it as "POC - nonbinding pilot". we need to avoid long-term payment terms bleed into product billing ops. include bill-to fields and PO number.
Diego (SE): security answers: yes we store keys in customer-managed KMS optional; default is our managed KMS with envelope encryption. retention: logs retained 90 days in Console by default; can export to S3 for longer. I'll draft a one-pager.
Sam (AE): can we aim to return counters + order form by Thurs? Contoso wants to start the week after.
Rina (Legal): I'll push back on escrow and reverse indemnity. Counteroffer: 1) mutual indemnity, 2) source escrow referral + commercial escrow vendor info, 3) limit audit windows to quarterly with notice.
Aisha (Buyer-Contoso): audit quarterly with notice is ok, but procurement insists on net45. is there a finance contact we can provide to expedite?
Tomas (Finance): we'll accept net45 for this pilot only. require invoice to reference PO-CONT-9091 and include cost center. Payment contact: ap@redwood.example.com.
contracts-bot: generated draft POC order form id=OF-2026-9910 and uploaded to /contracts/drafts/OF-2026-9910.pdf :paperclip:
Diego (SE): draft POC lines: 
```
Product: Redwood Trial - Short Trial SKU
Qty: 1
Period: 14 days
Resources: 1x GPU reserved, basic streaming
Price: $2,500 (infra) + $500 (support)
Billing: flat fee for trial (invoiced upfront) or net45 via PO request
SLA: reference Console SLOs; 99.5% expected availability
```
Rina (Legal): adding: include clause "This Order Form is a non-binding evaluation agreement and does not create a commitment to purchase beyond the period." mark counters limited to liability cap and escrow referral.
Sam (AE): Diego/Rina/Tomas I'll assemble the packet: itemized order form, security one-pager, and legal counters. Aisha can you confirm SOC report access email & preferred invoicing address?
Aisha (Buyer-Contoso): SOC access: secops@contoso.example.com. invoice to ap@contoso.example.com. we'll sign once counters match procurement needs.
Tomas (Finance): noted. also flag: taxes need to be visible on the invoice.
Diego (SE): I'll attach the security one-pager and monitoring expectations to the kickoff doc.
Sam (AE): plan: Rina posts counters by EOD Wed, contracts-bot attaches OF-2026-9910 (done), Diego sends security pack, Tomas confirms invoicing. target signature Thurs. :crossed_fingers:
Aisha (Buyer-Contoso): thanks all. we'll review and revert quickly.
Sam (AE): closing thread, will reopen if any redlines linger.
